text:
sarah_m: HelixEdge SI pinged — preflight for Accelerator private deploy. Two asks: 1) guidance on supported on-prem storage (NFS vs local NVMe) for model cache + shard placement, 2) how to map our billing SKUs for partner marketplace bundle. Can ops/solutions join a quick sync tomorrow?

eric_s: I can. TL;DR: latency-critical inference needs local NVMe for KV cache and model shards; NFS OK if they accept higher cold-starts and throughput limits. Also need eviction policy tuning for multi-model hosts.

maya_infra: +1. Also we require a Kubernetes CSI that supports volume scheduling with topology aware volumes. If partner uses appliance with local disks, we need node affinity hints. Example config snippet for us: 
```
cache:
  path: /var/redwood/cache
  type: nvme
  max_size_gb: 512
  eviction_policy: lru
```

eric_s: also note: model prefetch during rollout will spike disk IO. Recommend staggered rollout or pre-warming job that pulls bundles during a maintenance window.

sarah_m: HelixEdge wants to bundle Accelerator as part of their marketplace SKU. They asked if we can support both usage-based billing and a reserved license on the marketplace. Thoughts?

ben_sales: For marketplace listing we usually provide two SKUs: "Accelerator-Hosted-Reserved" (monthly commit) and "Accelerator-BYO-Hardware-License" (entitlement + meter). The meter can be a lightweight agent that reports hours and GB served. Need legal + procurement for pricing.

maya_infra: meter agent note: partner network policy may block outbound telemetry. We support both push (HTTPS to telemetry.redwood.ai) and offline ingestion (signed usage bundles uploaded by partner). The offline flow adds reconciliation lag.

eric_s: security: HelixEdge requires that model artifacts never be stored unencrypted on partner side. We can publish signed, encrypted bundles. We can also provide a verifier that runs locally. Engineering estimate: 4 days to add encryption + verifier to current bundle pipeline.

sarah_m: that's helpful. Can we present 3-option matrix to HelixEdge in the preflight call: (A) Local NVMe + push telemetry, (B) NFS + offline usage bundles, (C) Mirror + hardware-bundle SKU (no egress)?

eric_s: yes. I'll draft the matrix and include perf tradeoffs and ops runbook.

ben_sales: I'll sketch marketplace SKUs and pricing tiers to show to their procurement team.

maya_infra: quick infra reminder: if they choose local NVMe, we should document max concurrent model load and recommended node sizing (e.g., 8x A100-ish equivalence or 4x for lower tiers).

sarah_m: meeting scheduled 10:30 PT tomorrow with HelixEdge SI + procurement. Agenda: preflight matrix, storage config, telemetry options, SKU mapping, and legal checkpoints. Can everyone make it?

eric_s: yes. bringing a perf slide and prewarm job example.

maya_infra: yes. will bring CSI + deployment snippets.

ben_sales: attending. will invite procurement contact.

sarah_m: deploy-bot please create PARTNERS ticket and link to marketplace docs.

deploy-bot: ticket created: PARTNERS-4301 - "HelixEdge Accelerator: on-prem storage, telemetry, and marketplace SKU preflight" assigned to sarah_m, eric_s, maya_infra. Due: 4 business days.

sarah_m: thanks all. I'll drop the preflight doc here shortly: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/helixedge/preflight (internal) :rocket:

eric_s: one more: ask them whether their appliance supports S3-compatible local object stores (minio) — that gives the best of both worlds for large model blobs.

maya_infra: agreed. If minio present, we can use multipart downloads and accelerate warmups.

sarah_m: perfect. See you tomorrow.
